about.title: About Me
about.tags: FULL-STACK • UI UX DESIGNER • IT SUPPORT • DIGITAL MARKETING • AI ENTHUSIAST • WEB BUILDER • COPYWRITER
about.p1: I'm Alfin Almustajab, a multidisciplinary digital creator merging Full-Stack engineering, UI/UX Design, and modern Web Building based in Indonesia. I specialize in architecting scalable web applications, crafting intuitive human-centric interfaces, and leveraging cutting-edge intelligence as an active AI Enthusiast.
about.p2: Backed by solid technical expertise in IT Support ensuring robust infrastructure, complemented by strategic insights in Digital Marketing and impactful Copywriting, I deliver comprehensive digital solutions from resilient backend code to high-converting user experiences.

stack.title: Tech & AI Stack
stack.subtitle: A collection of technologies, architectural frameworks, and AI ecosystems leveraged to build production-grade modern software.
stack.frontendDesc: Reactive user interfaces & high-performance responsive designs crafted for peak accessibility.
stack.backendDesc: High-velocity microservices, secure RESTful / GraphQL APIs, and event-driven architectures.
stack.devopsDesc: Persistent ACID/NoSQL storage, message brokers, serverless cloud, and container orchestration.
stack.ragDesc: Building document search pipelines powered by Vector Databases (Chroma, Pinecone, pgvector) and intelligent reranking to produce hallucination-free responses for enterprise data.
stack.llmDesc: Integrating GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Google Gemini API into corporate workflows, automated document verification, function calling, and resilient multi-turn conversational AI.
